name.full: M365 Custom Engine Agent - A2A Proxy

description.short: Thin proxy agent to A2A orchestrator
description.full: A Microsoft 365 Custom Engine Agent that acts as a thin proxy, relaying messages from Teams and M365 Copilot to an existing A2A (Agent-to-Agent) orchestrator endpoint. No business logic lives here — all intelligence is in the orchestrator. Uses User-Assigned Managed Identity for zero-secret authentication.
